name: Minecraft (Universal)
author: hydra@wyvernlabs.de
description: Every Minecraft server software of mcjars.app in one egg: Vanilla, Paper, Purpur, Folia, Fabric, Quilt, Forge, NeoForge, Velocity, BungeeCord and many more. Pick the software with "Server Type" or switch it later on the Versions page of the server.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Hydra: installs any server software of mcjars.app (Paper, Purpur, Fabric,
# Forge, NeoForge, Quilt, Velocity, BungeeCord, ...). The version changer of
# the panel uses the same steps later on.
set -e
apk add --no-cache curl jq unzip ca-certificates >/dev/null

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

API="https://mcjars.app/api"
TYPE=$(echo "${SERVER_TYPE:-PAPER}" | tr 'a-z-' 'A-Z_')
JAR="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"

VERSIONS=$(curl -fsSL "${API}/v2/builds/${TYPE}") || { echo "Unknown server type ${TYPE}, see https://mcjars.app"; exit 1; }
VERSION="${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ] || ! echo "${VERSIONS}" | jq -e --arg v "${VERSION}" '.builds[$v]' >/dev/null; then
    if [ "${VERSION}" != "latest" ]; then
        echo "Version ${VERSION} not found, using the latest release."
    fi
    VERSION=$(echo "${VERSIONS}" | jq -r '[.builds | to_entries[] | select(.value.type == "RELEASE")] | last | .key')
fi

BUILDS=$(curl -fsSL "${API}/v2/builds/${TYPE}/${VERSION}")
if [ "${BUILD_NUMBER:-latest}" = "latest" ]; then
    BUILD=$(echo "${BUILDS}" | jq -c '.builds[0]')
else
    BUILD=$(echo "${BUILDS}" | jq -c --arg b "${BUILD_NUMBER}" '([.builds[] | select((.buildNumber | tostring) == $b or .name == $b or .name == ("#" + $b))][0]) // .builds[0]')
fi
echo "Installing ${TYPE} ${VERSION} ($(echo "${BUILD}" | jq -r '.name'))"

safe() {
    case "$1" in
        /* | *..*) echo "Refusing path $1"; exit 1 ;;
    esac
}

echo "${BUILD}" | jq -c '.installation[][]' > /tmp/steps
while read -r step; do
    case "$(echo "${step}" | jq -r '.type')" in
        download)
            file=$(echo "${step}" | jq -r '.file')
            safe "${file}"
            if [ "${file}" = "server.jar" ]; then
                file="${JAR}"
            fi
            mkdir -p "$(dirname "${file}")"
            echo "Downloading ${file}"
            curl -fsSL -o "${file}" "$(echo "${step}" | jq -r '.url')"
            ;;
        unzip)
            file=$(echo "${step}" | jq -r '.file')
            location=$(echo "${step}" | jq -r '.location')
            safe "${file}"
            safe "${location}"
            unzip -oq "${file}" -d "${location}"
            ;;
        remove)
            location=$(echo "${step}" | jq -r '.location')
            safe "${location}"
            rm -rf -- "${location}"
            ;;
    esac
done < /tmp/steps

# Forge, NeoForge and others unpack a server.jar of their own.
if [ "${JAR}" != "server.jar" ] && [ -f server.jar ]; then
    mv -f server.jar "${JAR}"
fi

if [ "${EULA:-false}" = "true" ] || [ "${EULA:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    echo "eula=true" > eula.txt
fi

echo "Installation finished."

variables.name: Server Type
variables.description: The server software from mcjars.app, e.g. PAPER, PURPUR, FOLIA, FABRIC, QUILT, FORGE, NEOFORGE, VANILLA, VELOCITY or BUNGEECORD.

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description: The version to install, e.g. 1.21.4. Leave at latest for the newest release.

variables.name: Build Number
variables.description: The build of the version, e.g. 232. Leave at latest for the newest build.

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the server jar file to run the server with.

variables.name: Accept EULA
variables.description: Accepts the Minecraft EULA (https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA) during the installation, so the server starts right away.
